snippet.title: DOOM 2553 Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
The Launch trailer for the Doom 3 Halo Mod: DOOM 2553.

Set in the year 2553, DOOM 2553 is a mod aiming to bring the events of Doom 3 into the Halo Universe. This includes character models, weapons, scenery objects, sounds and lore.

Doom 2553 can be found on ModDB:
https://www.moddb.com/mods/doom-3-2553

DOOM 2553 will be releasing the afternoon of October 5th, 2023. 


This trailer was made by Valkyries733, but was HEAVILY based off of a previously existing trailer made by Jack Price. The DOOM 2553 trailer is almost 1:1 with his trailer, and is intended to be a homage to his fan made trailer.

Jack Price's trailer can be found here:
https://youtu.be/M5NSUl6xtAY
